title: Endpoint-Aware Conditional Generation of Polymer Electrolytes with Molecular Dynamics Reassessment: Reproducibility Package
description: Frozen code, machine-readable data, molecular-dynamics inputs, representative structures, analysis scripts, and provenance for the JCIM submission reproducibility release.
notes: Release v1.0.0-jcim-submission, archived from GitHub main merge commit 830fa3ce5770a9b43bfc3439a381288c2a1a5254. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22043456. The record contains the frozen Git-tracked reproducibility package and two representative 50 ns GROMACS trajectory bundles.
